HISD Alert

Inline status banner. role="alert" (assertive) for errors, role="status" (polite) otherwise. Four semantic variants, each with a tinted surface, a matching-color leading icon, a heading and body in the text token, and an optional dismiss button. Meaning is carried by icon shape, the accent rail, and text — never color alone. Both themes are shown side by side, each demonstrating every state.

Light theme

Default theme. All states.

Copy-paste snippet

<!-- role="alert" for errors (assertive); role="status" otherwise (polite). -->
<div class="hisd-alert hisd-alert--danger" role="alert">
  <span class="hisd-alert__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
  <div class="hisd-alert__body">
    <p class="hisd-alert__title">Could not save changes</p>
    <p class="hisd-alert__message">The network connection was lost. Try again.</p>
  </div>
  <!-- Optional dismiss: icon-only, so it carries an aria-label. -->
  <button type="button" class="hisd-alert__dismiss"
          data-hisd-alert-dismiss aria-label="Dismiss this message">
    <span class="hisd-alert__dismiss-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
  </button>
</div>

<!-- Variants: hisd-alert--success | --warning | --danger | --info -->
